definitions.explanation: The physical act of turning something inside out or flipping it over, such as clothing or fabric.

definitions.gloss: the reverse, the opposite side, the flip side
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to mean the opposite or reverse side of something abstract, such as an emotion or situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{裏返|うらがえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: You're wearing your shirt inside out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{裏返|うらがえ}しにして⟦{洗濯|せんたく}する→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you turn your socks inside out before washing, the dirt comes off more easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{裏返|うらがえ}しにして⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I turned my pocket inside out to check the contents.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}しだ。
examples.english: That anger is the flip side of love.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}しだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think the strictness is the flip side of high expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寂|さび}しさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}しな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Her cold attitude might actually be the reverse side of loneliness.

notes:
{裏返|うらがえ}し has both a physical meaning (turning inside out) and a figurative one (the flip side of something).

SENSE 1 — PHYSICAL:
- {裏返|うらがえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn inside out/upside down
- {裏返|うらがえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear inside out
- {裏返|うらがえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to hang out to dry inside out
Commonly used with clothing, pockets, and fabric items.

SENSE 2 — FIGURATIVE:
The pattern A⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}し means "the flip side of A" — implying that a seemingly negative quality is actually a manifestation of something else.
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}し: anger is the flip side of love
- {厳|きび}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏返|うらがえ}し: strictness is the flip side of high expectations

RELATED WORDS:
The verb ⟦{裏返|うらがえ}す→裏返す：07508_uragaesu⟧ means to turn something inside out or to flip it over.
